summary.en: An explosion on the Japanese-run South Manchuria Railway near Mukden (Shenyang) is used as the pretext for Japan's occupation of north-east China.
summary.zh: 沈阳附近日本经营的南满铁路发生爆炸，日本以此为借口占领中国东北。

detail.en: The post-war Tokyo tribunal found that officers of the Army General Staff and the Kwantung Army had planned the explosion in advance to justify occupying Manchuria. At the time Japan blamed Chinese troops. In 1932 Japan set up Manchukuo, a state under Japanese army control that the League of Nations' Lytton report refused to recognise. Since 2017 Chinese textbooks date the War of Resistance from this day.
detail.zh: 战后东京审判认定，爆炸是日本陆军参谋本部和关东军军官事先策划的，目的是为占领东北制造借口；事变当时日方指称是中国军队所为。1932 年日本扶植成立“满洲国”，由日本军队控制，国际联盟的李顿报告拒绝承认。2017 年起，中国教材把抗日战争的起点定在这一天。

summary.en: Japanese and Chinese troops exchange fire near the Marco Polo Bridge outside Beiping; Japanese forces attack the walled town of Wanping, and the clash grows into full-scale war.
summary.zh: 日军与中国军队在北平城外卢沟桥附近交火，日军进攻宛平城，冲突随后扩大为全面战争。

detail.en: After the night clash of 7 July neither government stepped back, and the fighting spread across north China and, in August, to Shanghai. Neither side declared war: Japan called it the 'China Incident', and China's formal declaration came only on 9 December 1941. The Tokyo tribunal treated 7 July 1937 as the start of the second phase of Japan's war in China.
detail.zh: 7 月 7 日夜间交火后，两国政府都没有退让，战火蔓延到整个华北，8 月又烧到上海。双方都没有宣战：日本称之为“支那事变”，中国直到 1941 年 12 月 9 日才正式对日宣战。东京审判把 1937 年 7 月 7 日视为日本对华战争第二阶段的开始。

summary.en: Three months of fighting in and around Shanghai, with about 700,000 Chinese and 300,000 Japanese troops committed; the city falls in November.
summary.zh: 上海及周边三个月的战斗，中国先后投入约 70 万人，日本约 30 万人；11 月上海失守。

detail.en: 13 August – 26 November 1937. Troops committed over the whole battle: about 700,000 Chinese and 300,000 Japanese (Wilson). A Chinese report of 5 November counted 187,200 Chinese killed and wounded; later estimates are higher (a Japanese estimate put Chinese losses near 250,000). Japanese official records give over 40,000 Japanese killed and wounded (42,202 up to 8 November, not counting sickness).
detail.zh: 1937 年 8 月 13 日至 11 月 26 日。整场会战先后投入：中国约 70 万人，日本约 30 万人（Wilson）。中方 11 月 5 日的报告统计中国死伤 187,200 人，后来的估计更高（日方估计中国损失约 25 万）。日本官方记录日军死伤 4 万多人（截至 11 月 8 日为 42,202 人，不含病员）。

summary.en: After taking Nanjing on 13 December 1937, Japanese troops kill prisoners of war and civilians and rape women and girls over about six weeks.
summary.zh: 1937 年 12 月 13 日日军攻占南京后，在约六周里屠杀战俘和平民，强奸妇女。

detail.en: The International Military Tribunal for the Far East (1948) found that over 200,000 civilians and prisoners of war were killed in Nanjing and its vicinity in the first six weeks, that about 20,000 cases of rape occurred in the city in the first month, and noted that burial societies counted more than 155,000 bodies. The Nanjing War Crimes Tribunal (1947, judgment against Tani Hisao) found over 300,000 victims: more than 190,000 in mass killings and more than 150,000 bodies buried by charitable bodies. The Government of Japan states that the killing of non-combatants, looting and other acts cannot be denied, and that the number of victims is difficult to determine. Atlas lists both tribunal figures and does not choose between them.
detail.zh: 远东国际军事法庭（1948）认定，最初六周内在南京及附近被杀害的平民和战俘超过 20 万人，第一个月城内发生约 2 万起强奸案，并指出慈善团体掩埋尸体超过 15.5 万具。南京国防部审判战犯军事法庭（1947 年谷寿夫案判决）认定被害者 30 万人以上：集体屠杀 19 万余人，慈善机关收埋尸体 15 万余具。日本政府的立场是：杀害非战斗人员、掠夺等行为无法否认，遇难人数难以确定。本书并列两个法庭的数字，不作取舍。

summary.en: Britain's naval base at Sembawang, begun in 1928, is officially opened with the King George VI Dock; it is called the 'Gibraltar of the East'.
summary.zh: 英国在三巴旺修建的海军基地 1928 年动工，与乔治六世船坞一同正式启用，被称为“东方直布罗陀”。

detail.en: The base was built to receive a British fleet sent from Europe in an emergency; no large fleet was stationed there. Planning assumed the fleet could arrive within 70 days of war breaking out; in September 1939, with war in Europe, the Chiefs of Staff extended this 'period before relief' to 180 days.
detail.zh: 基地是为了在紧急时接纳从欧洲派来的英国舰队而修的，平时并没有大舰队驻扎。计划假定开战后 70 天内舰队可以赶到；1939 年 9 月欧洲开战后，参谋长委员会把这一“待援期”延长到 180 天。

summary.en: German troops march into Austria; the republic is dissolved and its territory incorporated into the German Reich.
summary.zh: 德军开进奥地利；奥地利共和国被取消，领土并入德国。

detail.en: Austria's chancellor Kurt Schuschnigg resigned under German pressure in favour of the Nazi Arthur Seyss-Inquart, and German troops entered the country. The annexation surrounded western Czechoslovakia on three sides.
detail.zh: 奥地利总理许士尼格在德国压力下辞职，由纳粹党人赛斯-英夸特接任，德军随即开入。合并之后，捷克斯洛伐克西部三面被德国包围。

summary.en: Japanese armies advance up the Yangtze and across the Dabie mountains; China's wartime centre Wuhan falls in late October 1938 and the government moves on to Chongqing.
summary.zh: 日军沿长江而上并越过大别山，1938 年 10 月下旬中国战时中心武汉失守，国民政府继续西迁重庆。

detail.en: The 11th Army advanced along both banks of the Yangtze (Anqing, Jiujiang, Tianjiazhen) while the 2nd Army crossed the Dabie mountains to the north; Japanese troops entered Hankou on 25–27 October. The Japanese official history gives about 9,500 Japanese killed and 26,000 wounded, with illness counted separately. China assembled about 90 divisions; the 9th War Zone alone reported about 200,000 killed, wounded and missing for June–November. After Wuhan, Japan stopped large offensives and the war in central China settled into a stalemate.
detail.zh: 第 11 军沿长江两岸推进（安庆、九江、田家镇），第 2 军从北面越过大别山；10 月 25 日至 27 日日军进入汉口。日本官方战史记录日军阵亡约 9,500 人、负伤约 2.6 万人，病员另计。中国为此集结了约 90 个师，仅第九战区就报告 6 月至 11 月死伤失踪约 20 万人。武汉失守后，日军停止大规模攻势，华中战局陷入相持。

summary.en: Britain, France, Germany and Italy agree that Czechoslovakia must hand its Sudeten areas to Germany; Czechoslovakia is not represented.
summary.zh: 英、法、德、意四国商定，捷克斯洛伐克必须把苏台德地区交给德国；捷克斯洛伐克没有代表在场。

detail.en: Signed by Hitler, Chamberlain, Daladier and Mussolini, the agreement set the evacuation of the Sudeten territory for 1–10 October 1938. Germany took areas with about 3.5 million people, 700,000 of them Czechs, and the Czechoslovak border fortifications. On 15 March 1939 German troops occupied the rest of Bohemia and Moravia; on 31 March Britain and France pledged to assist Poland if it were attacked.
detail.zh: 协定由希特勒、张伯伦、达拉第和墨索里尼签字，规定 1938 年 10 月 1 日至 10 日撤出苏台德地区。德国取得约 350 万人口的地区（其中 70 万是捷克人）以及捷克斯洛伐克的边境要塞。1939 年 3 月 15 日德军占领波希米亚和摩拉维亚其余部分；3 月 31 日英法承诺波兰遭到进攻时给予援助。

summary.en: Germany and the Soviet Union sign a non-aggression treaty in Moscow; a secret protocol divides eastern Europe into German and Soviet spheres.
summary.zh: 德国和苏联在莫斯科签订互不侵犯条约；一份秘密议定书把东欧划分为德苏两国的势力范围。

detail.en: The secret additional protocol drew the line between the two spheres along the northern border of Lithuania and, in Poland, along the rivers Narew, Vistula and San, and recorded Soviet interest in Bessarabia. Its existence was denied in the Soviet Union for fifty years; on 24 December 1989 the Congress of People's Deputies of the USSR confirmed that it had been signed, condemned it, and declared it invalid from the moment of signing.
detail.zh: 秘密附加议定书以立陶宛北部边界、并在波兰境内以纳雷夫河、维斯瓦河、桑河一线划分两国势力范围，还写明苏联对比萨拉比亚的利益。五十年间苏联一直否认有这份议定书；1989 年 12 月 24 日，苏联人民代表大会确认它确实签订过，予以谴责，并宣布它自签字之时起无效。

summary.en: About 1.5 million German troops attack Poland from the west, north and south; Britain and France declare war on Germany on 3 September.
summary.zh: 约 150 万德军从西、北、南三面进攻波兰；9 月 3 日英法对德宣战。

detail.en: On 31 August 1939 Germany had 55 divisions on the Polish frontier: 630,000 men in Army Group North (Pomerania and East Prussia) and 886,000 in Army Group South (Silesia and Slovakia). Warsaw, besieged and bombed, capitulated on 27 September with 140,000 troops; the last Polish force surrendered at Kock on 6 October. German Army losses were 8,082 killed, 27,278 wounded and 5,029 missing; the Germans claimed 694,000 prisoners of some 800,000 Polish soldiers.
detail.zh: 1939 年 8 月 31 日，德国在波兰边境部署了 55 个师：北方集团军群（波美拉尼亚和东普鲁士）63 万人，南方集团军群（西里西亚和斯洛伐克）88.6 万人。华沙被围困、轰炸，9 月 27 日投降，守军 14 万人；最后一支波兰部队 10 月 6 日在科克投降。德国陆军阵亡 8,082 人，负伤 27,278 人，失踪 5,029 人；德方称俘虏 69.4 万人，而波兰参战军人约 80 万。

summary.en: Red Army troops cross Poland's eastern border at dawn on 17 September; Germany and the Soviet Union divide the country between them.
summary.zh: 9 月 17 日拂晓，苏军越过波兰东部边界；德国和苏联随后瓜分了波兰。

detail.en: The Soviet government told the German ambassador at 2 a.m. that its troops would cross at 6 a.m. Polish sources give more than 600,000 Soviet soldiers, about 4,700 tanks and 3,300 aircraft; some 250,000 Polish soldiers became Soviet prisoners. A German–Soviet treaty of 28 September fixed the new border, mostly along the rivers Narew, Bug and San. Many of the officers taken prisoner were among those shot at Katyn and elsewhere in spring 1940.
detail.zh: 苏联政府凌晨 2 时通知德国大使，苏军将在 6 时越境。据波方资料，苏联动用 60 多万军人、约 4,700 辆坦克和 3,300 架飞机；约 25 万名波兰军人成为苏军俘虏。9 月 28 日德苏签订条约确定新的边界，大部分沿纳雷夫河、布格河和桑河划定。被俘的军官中有许多人后来在 1940 年春的卡廷等地被枪杀。

summary.en: On a Soviet Politburo decision of 5 March 1940, the NKVD shoots about 22,000 Polish officers, police and members of the intelligentsia at Katyn and other sites.
summary.zh: 根据苏共中央政治局 1940 年 3 月 5 日的决定，内务人民委员部在卡廷等地枪杀了约 2.2 万名波兰军官、警察和知识界人士。

detail.en: The prisoners had been taken after the Soviet invasion of Poland. In 1959 the KGB chairman reported to Khrushchev that 21,857 had been shot, 4,421 of them in the Katyn forest near Smolensk; others were killed at Kalinin (Tver), Kharkiv and prisons in the western Ukraine and Belorussia. The Soviet Union blamed Germany for fifty years. On 13 April 1990 it admitted that the NKVD under Beria was responsible.
detail.zh: 这些人是苏联入侵波兰后被俘的。1959 年克格勃主席向赫鲁晓夫报告，被枪杀者共 21,857 人，其中 4,421 人在斯摩棱斯克附近的卡廷森林，其余在加里宁（特维尔）、哈尔科夫以及乌克兰西部和白俄罗斯西部的监狱。五十年间苏联一直归咎于德国。1990 年 4 月 13 日，苏联承认这是贝利亚领导的内务人民委员部所为。

summary.en: German forces occupy Denmark and land at the main Norwegian ports, from Oslo to Narvik, on 9 April 1940; Norway's army fights on with British, French and Polish help until 10 June.
summary.zh: 1940 年 4 月 9 日德军占领丹麦，并在从奥斯陆到纳尔维克的挪威各主要港口登陆；挪威军队在英、法、波兰部队支援下坚持到 6 月 10 日。

detail.en: A first echelon of 8,850 German soldiers was carried in warships to take the ports by surprise. Allied troops recaptured Narvik on 28 May but were withdrawn by 8 June because of the German offensive in France. Land casualties: British 1,869, French and Polish about 530, Norwegian 1,335; the German General Staff counted 5,296, including losses at sea.
detail.zh: 德军第一梯队 8,850 人由军舰运送，突袭夺取各港口。盟军 5 月 28 日夺回纳尔维克，但因德军在法国发动攻势，6 月 8 日前全部撤走。陆上伤亡：英军 1,869 人，法军和波兰军约 530 人，挪威军 1,335 人；德国总参谋部统计德军 5,296 人，含海上损失。

summary.en: While Allied armies move into Belgium, German armoured divisions cross the Ardennes, force the Meuse at Sedan on 13 May and reach the Channel at Abbeville on 20 May.
summary.zh: 盟军主力开进比利时的同时，德军装甲师穿过阿登山区，5 月 13 日在色当强渡默兹河，5 月 20 日在阿布维尔到达英吉利海峡。

detail.en: The French command had judged the wooded Ardennes impracticable for tanks and held the Meuse there with second-line divisions. Panzer Group Kleist, about 134,000 men with over 1,200 tanks, came through the forest roads; the drive to the sea cut off the British, French and Belgian armies in the north. German planners later called it the 'sickle cut' (Sichelschnitt).
detail.zh: 法军统帅部认为树林密布的阿登山区坦克无法通行，那一段默兹河只由二线师防守。约 13.4 万人、1,200 多辆坦克的克莱斯特装甲集群沿林间道路穿过阿登；直插海边的攻势把英、法、比三国在北面的军队切断在包围圈里。德方后来把这次行动称为“镰刀收割”。

summary.en: From 26 May to 4 June, 338,226 British and Allied soldiers are taken from Dunkirk to England by naval and civilian ships.
summary.zh: 5 月 26 日至 6 月 4 日，338,226 名英国和盟国士兵由海军舰艇和民船从敦刻尔克撤到英国。

detail.en: Operation Dynamo lifted nearly 100,000 men from the open beaches and the rest from the harbour mole. After the evacuation was opened to them, 139,097 Allied troops, most of them French, were brought away. The British Expeditionary Force left almost all its heavy equipment behind. French rearguards held the perimeter until 4 June; about 1.8 million French soldiers were taken prisoner in the whole campaign.
detail.zh: “发电机行动”中近 10 万人是从开阔的海滩上撤走的，其余从港口防波堤登船。撤离向盟军开放后，共撤出 139,097 名盟国军人，大多是法国人。英国远征军几乎丢下了全部重装备。法军后卫守住环形阵地直到 6 月 4 日；整个法国战役中约 180 万法军被俘。

summary.en: German troops enter Paris, which the French government has left undefended; the government has moved to Bordeaux.
summary.zh: 德军开进巴黎；法国政府没有设防，已迁往波尔多。

detail.en: On the morning of 14 June General Weygand told the British commander that organised resistance by the French armies as a whole had come to an end. Italy had declared war on France and Britain on 10 June.
detail.zh: 6 月 14 日上午，魏刚将军告诉英军指挥官，法军整体上已无法组织抵抗。6 月 10 日意大利已对法英宣战。

summary.en: France signs an armistice with Germany at Compiègne; Germany occupies the north and the Atlantic coast, and a French government at Vichy under Marshal Pétain keeps the rest.
summary.zh: 法国在贡比涅与德国签订停战协定；德国占领北部和大西洋沿岸，其余地区由贝当元帅领导、设在维希的法国政府管辖。

detail.en: The armistice was signed at 6.50 p.m. on 22 June 1940 in the Forest of Compiègne. On 10 July the National Assembly gave Pétain full powers by 569 votes to 80; this became the legal basis of the Vichy regime, which collaborated with Germany. In London, General de Gaulle had already called on the French on 18 June to continue the fight.
detail.zh: 停战协定于 1940 年 6 月 22 日下午 6 时 50 分在贡比涅森林签字。7 月 10 日，国民议会以 569 票对 80 票授予贝当全权，这成了与德国合作的维希政权的法律基础。在此之前的 6 月 18 日，戴高乐将军已在伦敦号召法国人继续战斗。

title.en: Battle of Britain and the Blitz
title.zh: 不列颠之战与伦敦大轰炸

summary.en: The German air force tries to win control of the air over southern England as a step towards invasion; it does not succeed, and from September it bombs London and other cities at night.
summary.zh: 德国空军企图夺取英格兰南部上空的制空权，为登陆做准备；它没有成功，从 9 月起转为夜间轰炸伦敦等城市。

detail.en: Between 10 July and 31 October 1940 about 1,733 German and 915 British aircraft were destroyed; 544 RAF Fighter Command pilots and about 2,500 German airmen were killed. The German invasion plan was postponed indefinitely on 17 September. Night bombing of British cities continued until May 1941; over the whole war 51,509 civilians in the United Kingdom were killed by bombing.
detail.zh: 1940 年 7 月 10 日至 10 月 31 日，德国飞机约 1,733 架、英国飞机 915 架被毁；英国皇家空军战斗机司令部 544 名飞行员和约 2,500 名德国空勤人员丧生。9 月 17 日德国无限期推迟了登陆计划。对英国城市的夜间轰炸一直持续到 1941 年 5 月；整个战争中英国有 51,509 名平民死于轰炸。

summary.en: Germany and its allies invade the Soviet Union along a front from the Baltic to the Black Sea with about 3 million German troops in three army groups.
summary.zh: 德国及其盟国沿着从波罗的海到黑海的战线入侵苏联，约 300 万德军分三个集团军群进攻。

detail.en: The attack began at 3 a.m. on 22 June 1941 with complete tactical surprise. The German Army assembled 145 divisions, 3,050,000 men, 3,350 tanks, 7,184 guns and 625,000 horses; Romanian and, from 25 June, Finnish forces joined. According to most Soviet accounts the western military districts had 2.9 million men.
detail.zh: 进攻于 1941 年 6 月 22 日凌晨 3 时开始，完全达成了战术突然性。德国陆军集结 145 个师、305 万人、坦克 3,350 辆、火炮 7,184 门、马 62.5 万匹；罗马尼亚军队，以及 6 月 25 日起的芬兰军队一同参战。据多数苏方记载，苏联西部各军区共有 290 万人。

title.en: Southern Indochina and the oil embargo
title.zh: 进驻南印度支那与石油禁运

summary.en: Japanese troops move into southern French Indochina; the United States, Britain and the Netherlands East Indies freeze Japanese assets, cutting off Japan's oil imports.
summary.zh: 日军进驻法属印度支那南部；美国、英国和荷属东印度冻结日本资产，切断了日本的石油进口。

detail.en: Under an agreement forced on the Vichy government, Japanese troops occupied Saigon and Cam Ranh Bay at the end of July 1941. The United States froze Japanese assets on 26 July; Britain and the Netherlands East Indies followed. Japan's own oil production met only about a tenth of its needs, and its reserves would last about three years in peace and much less in war. Japan's leaders prepared to take the oil of the Netherlands East Indies by force if negotiations failed.
detail.zh: 根据强加给维希政府的协议，日军 1941 年 7 月底占领西贡和金兰湾。美国 7 月 26 日冻结日本资产，英国和荷属东印度随后跟进。日本本国石油产量只够需求的约一成，储备在和平时期约够三年，战时则短得多。日本领导层准备在谈判失败时以武力夺取荷属东印度的石油。

summary.en: German armies from north and south close a pocket east of Kyiv; the city falls on 19 September and the Germans claim 665,000 prisoners.
summary.zh: 德军从南北两面在基辅以东合围；基辅 9 月 19 日失守，德方称俘虏 66.5 万人。

detail.en: Hitler turned Guderian's Second Panzer Group south from the Moscow axis in late August. The pincers met near Lokhvytsia on 15 September and the pocket was cleared by 26 September. The diversion delayed the attack on Moscow until October.
detail.zh: 8 月下旬，希特勒把古德里安的第 2 装甲集群从莫斯科方向调往南方。两路钳形攻势 9 月 15 日在洛赫维察附近会合，到 9 月 26 日包围圈被肃清。这次转兵把对莫斯科的进攻推迟到了 10 月。

summary.en: German and Finnish forces cut Leningrad's land links on 8 September 1941; the siege lasts 872 days, and hundreds of thousands of civilians die, most of them of hunger.
summary.zh: 1941 年 9 月 8 日德国和芬兰军队切断列宁格勒的陆上交通；围城持续 872 天，数十万平民死亡，大多是饿死的。

detail.en: Hitler ordered that the city be surrounded and starved rather than taken. The Leningrad commission's figure presented at Nuremberg was 632,253 dead from the hunger blockade; the historian Anna Reid puts the city's total deaths at 700,000–800,000, one in three or four of the pre-siege population. Supplies came only across Lake Ladoga, by boat in summer and over the ice in winter. The siege was fully lifted on 27 January 1944; about 1.5 million soldiers and civilians died in and around the city.
detail.zh: 希特勒下令包围城市、饿死城中居民，而不是攻进去。列宁格勒调查委员会在纽伦堡提出的数字是因饥饿封锁死亡 632,253 人；历史学家安娜·里德估计全城死亡 70 万到 80 万人，相当于围城前人口的三分之一到四分之一。补给只能经拉多加湖运进：夏天走船，冬天走冰上道路。1944 年 1 月 27 日围城完全解除；城内外军民约 150 万人死亡。

summary.en: Over two days German SS and police units shoot 33,771 Jews from Kyiv at the Babi Yar ravine on the edge of the city.
summary.zh: 两天内，德国党卫队和警察部队在基辅城边的娘子谷峡谷枪杀了 33,771 名基辅犹太人。

detail.en: After explosions in occupied Kyiv, the Jews remaining in the city were ordered to assemble on 29 September. Sonderkommando 4a of Einsatzgruppe C, under Paul Blobel, with SS and police battalions, shot them in small groups; the number comes from the unit's own report to Berlin. Behind the whole Eastern Front the Einsatzgruppen and other units killed well over a million civilians, most of them Jews. Babi Yar remained a killing site throughout the occupation.
detail.zh: 被占领的基辅发生爆炸后，城内剩下的犹太人被勒令于 9 月 29 日集合。特别行动队 C 队第 4a 特遣队（指挥官保罗·布洛贝尔）会同党卫队和警察营，把他们分成小批枪杀；这个数字来自该部队自己向柏林的报告。在整个东线后方，特别行动队等部队杀害了远超 100 万名平民，大多是犹太人。整个占领期间，娘子谷一直是屠杀地点。

summary.en: The German offensive on Moscow (Operation Typhoon) reaches the outskirts of the city but stops in the cold; the Red Army counter-attacks on 5–6 December.
summary.zh: 德军进攻莫斯科（“台风”行动），打到城郊后在严寒中停住；12 月 5 日至 6 日苏军发起反攻。

detail.en: Encirclements at Vyazma and Bryansk in October took hundreds of thousands of prisoners, then autumn mud slowed the advance. By late November German losses since 22 June had passed 740,000 men, winter clothing had been ordered for only 60 divisions, and temperatures fell to −38 °F (about −39 °C). The Soviet counter-offensive drove the Germans back from the city by early January 1942.
detail.zh: 10 月在维亚济马和布良斯克的包围战又俘虏了数十万人，随后秋季泥泞拖慢了进攻。到 11 月下旬，德军自 6 月 22 日以来的损失已超过 74 万人，冬装只为 60 个师订购，气温降到华氏零下 38 度（约零下 39 摄氏度）。到 1942 年 1 月初，苏军反攻把德军从莫斯科城下击退。

summary.en: Japanese carrier aircraft attack the US Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor, Hawaii; 2,403 Americans are killed. The US declares war on Japan the next day.
summary.zh: 日本航母舰载机袭击夏威夷珍珠港的美国太平洋舰队，2,403 名美国人死亡。次日美国对日宣战。

detail.en: Two waves of carrier aircraft struck between about 7.55 and 9.45 a.m. local time on Sunday 7 December (8 December in Asia). All eight battleships of the Pacific Fleet were sunk or put out of action, 188 aircraft were destroyed, and 2,403 US service personnel and civilians were killed and 1,178 wounded. Japan lost 29 aircraft and five midget submarines. The three US fleet carriers were not in harbour. The landing at Kota Bharu in Malaya had begun about 70 minutes earlier.
detail.zh: 两波舰载机在夏威夷时间 12 月 7 日（星期日，亚洲是 12 月 8 日）上午约 7 时 55 分至 9 时 45 分发动攻击。太平洋舰队八艘战列舰全部被击沉或失去战斗力，188 架飞机被毁，美国军人和平民 2,403 人死亡、1,178 人受伤。日方损失飞机 29 架和五艘袖珍潜艇。美国三艘舰队航母当时不在港内。马来亚哥打巴鲁的登陆比这里早约 70 分钟。

summary.en: Shortly after midnight on 8 December, about 5,600 Japanese troops land at Kota Bharu in north-east Malaya, about 70 minutes before the attack on Pearl Harbor.
summary.zh: 12 月 8 日午夜过后，约 5,600 名日军在马来亚东北部的哥打巴鲁登陆，比珍珠港攻击早约 70 分钟。

detail.en: The landing was planned for 00:45 local time (17:15 GMT on 7 December), the Pearl Harbor attack for 18:25 GMT. The first flight at Kota Bharu was about 5,590 men of the 56th Infantry Regiment (Takumi Detachment); at the same time about 13,500 landed at Singora and 7,550 at Patani in southern Thailand. Indian troops of 8th Brigade held the beaches; Hudson bombers from the airfield damaged all three transports, and one sank the next day.
detail.zh: 登陆计划在当地时间 0 时 45 分（格林尼治 7 日 17 时 15 分），珍珠港攻击在格林尼治 18 时 25 分。哥打巴鲁的第一批是第 56 联队（佗美支队）约 5,590 人；同时约 13,500 人在泰国南部宋卡、7,550 人在北大年登陆。守卫海滩的是印度第 8 旅；从机场起飞的哈德逊轰炸机击伤全部三艘运输船，其中一艘次日沉没。

summary.en: Japanese forces attack the British colony of Hong Kong on 8 December; the garrison of British, Canadian, Indian and local troops surrenders on 25 December.
summary.zh: 12 月 8 日日军进攻英国殖民地香港；由英国、加拿大、印度和本地部队组成的守军于 12 月 25 日投降。

detail.en: The fighting and the capitulation cost the garrison 11,848 men, most as prisoners; battle casualties were about 4,440, probably an underestimate. Official Japanese casualties were 675 killed and 2,079 wounded.
detail.zh: 战斗和投降使守军损失 11,848 人，大多数成为战俘；战斗伤亡约 4,440 人，可能偏低。日本官方记录日军阵亡 675 人、负伤 2,079 人。

summary.en: Shortly after 4 a.m. on 8 December, 17 Japanese bombers from Indochina attack Singapore's city and air bases; 61 people are killed and 133 injured.
summary.zh: 12 月 8 日凌晨 4 时过后，17 架从印度支那起飞的日本轰炸机袭击新加坡市区和机场，61 人死亡、133 人受伤。

detail.en: The city was fully lit; the street lamps were not put out until the all-clear at 4.40 a.m. By January 1942 there were two to three raids a day. For January, Kirby gives some 600 civilians killed and 1,500 injured; a Singapore government account gives more than 1,000 killed. Both figures are listed.
detail.zh: 空袭时全城灯火通明，路灯直到凌晨 4 时 40 分解除警报后才熄灭。到 1942 年 1 月，每天有两三次空袭。关于 1 月的伤亡，Kirby 记为平民约 600 人死亡、1,500 人受伤；新加坡政府的资料写 1,000 多人死亡。两者并列。

summary.en: Hours after Pearl Harbor, Japanese aircraft from Formosa catch much of the US air force in the Philippines on the ground at Clark Field.
summary.zh: 珍珠港事件几小时后，从台湾起飞的日本飞机在克拉克机场把美国驻菲律宾空军的大部分飞机炸毁在地面上。

detail.en: Although news of Pearl Harbor had reached Manila hours earlier, the aircraft were caught on the ground. After one day of war the Far East Air Force had lost half its strength: only 17 of 35 B-17 bombers remained.
detail.zh: 虽然珍珠港的消息几小时前就已传到马尼拉，飞机仍在地面上遭到袭击。开战一天，远东航空队就损失了一半：35 架 B-17 轰炸机只剩 17 架。

summary.en: Congress declares war on Japan on 8 December; on 11 December Germany and Italy declare war on the United States, and Congress declares war on them the same day.
summary.zh: 12 月 8 日美国国会对日宣战；12 月 11 日德国和意大利对美宣战，国会当天也对两国宣战。

detail.en: The House voted for war with Japan immediately after President Roosevelt's address; only Representative Jeannette Rankin voted against. With these declarations the wars in Europe, China and the Pacific became one war.
detail.zh: 罗斯福总统演说后，众议院随即表决对日宣战，只有珍妮特·兰金一人投反对票。这几份宣战书让欧洲、中国和太平洋的战争连成了一场战争。

title.en: Sinking of Prince of Wales and Repulse
title.zh: 威尔士亲王号与反击号沉没

summary.en: Japanese naval aircraft from Indochina sink the British battleship Prince of Wales and battlecruiser Repulse off Kuantan; about 840 men are killed.
summary.zh: 从印度支那起飞的日本海军飞机在关丹外海击沉英国战列舰威尔士亲王号和战列巡洋舰反击号，约 840 人丧生。

detail.en: Force Z had sailed from Singapore to attack the landings in Thailand and Malaya without fighter cover. Repulse sank at 12.33 p.m. and Prince of Wales at 1.20 p.m. on 10 December. Of 1,612 aboard Prince of Wales 1,285 were rescued; of 1,309 aboard Repulse 796 were rescued — about 840 lost, including Admiral Tom Phillips. Japan lost three aircraft. With the US fleet hit at Pearl Harbor three days earlier, Japan held control of the seas around Malaya.
detail.zh: Z 舰队在没有战斗机掩护的情况下从新加坡出发，准备攻击泰国和马来亚的登陆部队。12 月 10 日中午 12 时 33 分反击号沉没，1 时 20 分威尔士亲王号沉没。威尔士亲王号 1,612 人中获救 1,285 人，反击号 1,309 人中获救 796 人，约 840 人丧生，包括菲利普斯海军上将。日方损失飞机 3 架。加上三天前美国舰队在珍珠港受重创，日本掌握了马来亚周边的制海权。

summary.en: A Japanese tank column breaks through two Indian brigades at the Slim River; Kuala Lumpur falls four days later.
summary.zh: 日军坦克纵队在仕林河突破两个印度旅的防线；四天后吉隆坡失守。

detail.en: Before dawn on 7 January a company of Japanese tanks with motorised infantry drove down the trunk road through the Trolak and Slim River positions and took the Slim River bridge intact. 12th Indian Brigade virtually ceased to exist and 28th Brigade was reduced to a third of its strength. Japanese troops entered Kuala Lumpur at 8 p.m. on 11 January.
detail.zh: 1 月 7 日拂晓前，一个日军坦克中队带着摩托化步兵沿干道冲过特罗拉和仕林河阵地，完整夺下仕林河大桥。印度第 12 旅几乎不复存在，第 28 旅只剩三分之一。1 月 11 日晚 8 时日军进入吉隆坡。

summary.en: American and Filipino troops hold the Bataan peninsula for three months; about 78,000 surrender on 9 April 1942, and the prisoners are forced on a 65-mile march.
summary.zh: 美菲军队在巴丹半岛坚持了三个月；1942 年 4 月 9 日约 7.8 万人投降，战俘被迫徒步行军 65 英里。

detail.en: After landing at Lingayen Gulf on 22 December with 43,110 men, the Japanese 14th Army entered Manila on 2 January 1942. MacArthur's forces withdrew into Bataan, where hunger and disease wore them down. On the 'death march' from Mariveles to San Fernando prisoners were denied food and water, beaten and bayoneted; thousands died. Corregidor surrendered on 6 May.
detail.zh: 日军第 14 军 12 月 22 日率 43,110 人在林加延湾登陆，1942 年 1 月 2 日进入马尼拉。麦克阿瑟的部队退入巴丹半岛，在饥饿和疾病中消耗殆尽。在从马里韦莱斯到圣费尔南多的“死亡行军”中，战俘得不到食物和水，遭到殴打和刺刀刺杀，数千人死亡。科雷希多岛 5 月 6 日投降。

summary.en: On the night of 8 February Japanese troops cross the Johor Strait and land on Singapore's north-west coast near Sarimbun, held by the 22nd Australian Brigade.
summary.zh: 2 月 8 日夜，日军渡过柔佛海峡，在新加坡西北海岸沙林汶一带登陆，那里由澳大利亚第 22 旅防守。

detail.en: After days of shelling, landing craft of the Japanese 5th and 18th Divisions attacked the coast between Tanjong Buloh and Tanjong Murai at about 10.30 p.m.; the heaviest assaults were north of Pulau Sarimbun. The defended localities were far apart and the Japanese moved inland between them. The Causeway had been breached on 31 January when the last Commonwealth troops crossed to the island.
detail.zh: 经过几天炮击，日军第 5、第 18 师团的登陆艇在晚上约 10 时 30 分进攻丹戎布罗至丹戎木莱一带海岸，最猛烈的进攻在沙林汶岛以北。守军据点相距很远，日军从中间穿插向内陆推进。1 月 31 日最后一批英联邦部队撤到岛上时，长堤已被炸开缺口。

summary.en: Japanese troops take Bukit Timah, the island's highest ground, in the centre of the island near the reservoirs that supply the city's water.
summary.zh: 日军攻占全岛最高处武吉知马，那里位于岛中央，靠近供应全城用水的水库。

detail.en: Fighting along the Bukit Timah road lasted from 10 to 11 February. By the morning of 14 February breaks in the water mains from bombing and shelling were losing more than half the supply from the reservoirs, and the municipal water engineer estimated it might last 24 to 48 hours.
detail.zh: 武吉知马路一带的战斗从 2 月 10 日持续到 11 日。到 2 月 14 日早上，轰炸和炮击打断的水管使水库一半以上的供水白白流失，市政水务工程师估计供水最多还能维持 24 到 48 小时。

summary.en: The Malay Regiment defends Pasir Panjang ridge and Bukit Chandu (Opium Hill) against the Japanese 18th Division; Lieutenant Adnan Saidi is captured and killed.
summary.zh: 马来军团在巴西班让山脊和武吉知卓（鸦片山）抵抗日军第 18 师团；阿南·赛迪中尉被俘后遇害。

detail.en: The Japanese 56th Infantry Regiment attacked the Pasir Panjang ridge on 13 February and took The Gap that evening. C Company of the 1st Battalion, Malay Regiment, held Bukit Chandu until the afternoon of 14 February. Second Lieutenant Adnan Saidi was captured and killed. The site is now the Reflections at Bukit Chandu museum.
detail.zh: 日军第 56 联队 2 月 13 日进攻巴西班让山脊，当晚夺取峡口。马来军团第一营 C 连守住武吉知卓直到 14 日下午。阿南·赛迪少尉被俘后遇害。那里现在是“武吉知卓之忆”纪念馆。

summary.en: Japanese soldiers enter the British Military Hospital at Alexandra and kill about 200 patients and staff over two days.
summary.zh: 日军士兵闯入亚历山大英军医院，两天内杀害约 200 名病人和医护人员。

detail.en: On 14 February soldiers bayoneted 50 unarmed patients and medical staff in the wards, including a patient on the operating table. About 200 patients and staff were marched to another building, held overnight without water, and shot the next day. Kirby records the Japanese claim that the hospital had been used as an artillery position. The hospital had twice as many patients as beds.
detail.zh: 2 月 14 日，日军士兵在病房里用刺刀杀死 50 名手无寸铁的病人和医护人员，其中包括手术台上的病人。约 200 名病人和医护人员被押到另一栋楼，关了一夜，没有水，次日被枪杀。Kirby 记录了日方的说法：医院曾被用作炮兵阵地。当时医院的病人是床位的两倍。

summary.en: Lieutenant-General Percival signs the surrender of Singapore to Lieutenant-General Yamashita at the Ford factory, Bukit Timah; fighting stops at 8.30 p.m.
summary.zh: 白思华中将在武吉知马福特车厂向山下奉文中将签字投降；晚上 8 时 30 分停火。

detail.en: Percival arrived at 5.15 p.m., Yamashita demanded unconditional surrender, and Percival signed at 6.10 p.m. The island garrison was about 85,000 men; over the 70-day campaign more than 130,000 British, Indian, Australian and local troops became prisoners. For Singapore it began three years and eight months of Japanese occupation; 15 February is now Total Defence Day.
detail.zh: 白思华下午 5 时 15 分到达，山下要求无条件投降，6 时 10 分白思华签字。岛上守军约 85,000 人；整个 70 天的战役中，英国、印度、澳大利亚和本地部队共 13 万多人成为战俘。新加坡由此进入三年零八个月的日据时期；2 月 15 日现在是全面防卫日。

summary.en: Japanese military police and soldiers screen Chinese men aged 18 to 50 across Singapore and take those they suspect of being anti-Japanese to beaches and other remote places to be shot.
summary.zh: 日本宪兵和军队在新加坡各地甄别 18 至 50 岁的华人男子，把被怀疑“抗日”的人押到海滩等偏僻地方枪杀。

detail.en: The screening ran from 18 February to 4 March 1942, carried out mainly by the Kempeitai in the city and by the Imperial Guard Division in the suburbs. Known killing sites include Changi Beach (66 men, 20 February) and Punggol beach (some 400, 28 February). The Japanese figure at the 1947 trial was about 5,000; a 25th Army record of May 1942 lists 11,110 'missing'; most estimates lie between 25,000 and 50,000, and Chinese community estimates go up to 100,000. The marker shows the screening centre at Jalan Besar, one of several.
detail.zh: 检证从 1942 年 2 月 18 日持续到 3 月 4 日，市区主要由宪兵队执行，郊区由近卫师团执行。已知的屠杀地点包括樟宜海滩（2 月 20 日，66 人）和榜鹅海滩（2 月 28 日，约 400 人）。1947 年审判时日方的数字约 5,000 人；第 25 军 1942 年 5 月的记录写有 11,110 人“失踪”；多数估计在 2.5 万至 5 万人之间，华人社会的估计最高到 10 万人。地图上的标记是惹兰勿刹的检证中心，这样的中心有好几处。

summary.en: Executive Order 9066 leads to the forced removal of about 122,000 people of Japanese descent from the US West Coast to inland camps such as Manzanar; nearly 70,000 are US citizens.
summary.zh: 第 9066 号行政令导致约 12.2 万名日裔被强制从美国西海岸迁往曼赞纳等内陆营地；其中近 7 万人是美国公民。

detail.en: President Roosevelt signed the order on 19 February 1942. Families were given days to leave their homes, held in assembly centres and then in ten guarded camps in the western states and Arkansas. No charges were made against them and most lost their homes and property. In 1988 Congress acknowledged the injustice, apologised, and paid $20,000 to each surviving person who had been incarcerated.
detail.zh: 罗斯福总统 1942 年 2 月 19 日签署这项命令。日裔家庭只有几天时间离开住所，先被关进临时集合中心，再被送进西部各州和阿肯色州的十个有人看守的营地。政府没有对他们提出任何指控，多数人失去了住房和财产。1988 年国会承认这是不公正的，正式道歉，并向每位在世的被监禁者赔偿 2 万美元。

summary.en: Japan forces Allied prisoners of war and Asian labourers to build a 415 km railway between Thailand and Burma; about 12,000 prisoners and 75,000–90,000 labourers die.
summary.zh: 日本强迫盟军战俘和亚洲劳工修建泰缅之间 415 公里的铁路；约 1.2 万名战俘和 7.5 万至 9 万名劳工死亡。

detail.en: The line ran from Nong Pladuk in Thailand to Thanbyuzayat in Burma, crossing the border at the Three Pagodas Pass (marked here), and was joined on 17 October 1943. Prisoners from Changi travelled five days by train to Ban Pong. Of 62,000 Allied prisoners who worked on it, 11,979 died; of about 200,000 Asian labourers, between 75,000 (Australian War Memorial) and 90,000 (Australian Department of Veterans' Affairs) died, most of them with no marked grave. Hunger, cholera, malaria and the 'speedo' push of the 1943 monsoon caused most deaths.
detail.zh: 铁路从泰国农布拉杜克通到缅甸丹彪扎亚，在三塔山口（图上标记处）越过边界，1943 年 10 月 17 日接通。樟宜的战俘坐五天火车到班蓬。参加修路的 62,000 名盟军战俘中 11,979 人死亡；约 20 万名亚洲劳工中，死亡人数在 7.5 万（澳大利亚战争纪念馆）到 9 万（澳大利亚退伍军人事务部）之间，大多没有标明的坟墓。饥饿、霍乱、疟疾，以及 1943 年雨季里日军喊着“快点”（speedo）的赶工，是大多数人的死因。

summary.en: US carrier aircraft sink the four Japanese fleet carriers sent to take Midway; Japan loses about 3,057 men, the United States about 362 and the carrier Yorktown.
summary.zh: 美国舰载机击沉前来攻占中途岛的四艘日本舰队航母；日本损失约 3,057 人，美国损失约 362 人和约克城号航母。

detail.en: Japan planned to take Midway atoll and draw the US Pacific Fleet into a decisive battle. US Navy codebreakers at Station Hypo in Hawaii confirmed the target, code-named 'AF', after Midway sent a false message that it was short of fresh water and a Japanese signal reported that 'AF' was short of water. On 4 June American carrier aircraft sank Akagi, Kaga, Soryu and Hiryu. Yorktown, damaged, was sunk by a Japanese submarine on 7 June. Four of the six carriers that had attacked Pearl Harbor were gone.
detail.zh: 日本计划攻占中途岛环礁，引美国太平洋舰队出来决战。夏威夷“Hypo 站”的美国海军破译员确认了目标代号“AF”：中途岛故意发出淡水短缺的假电报，随后日方电报报告“AF 缺水”。6 月 4 日，美国舰载机击沉赤城、加贺、苍龙和飞龙。受伤的约克城号 6 月 7 日被日本潜艇击沉。袭击珍珠港的六艘航母，已有四艘沉没。

summary.en: US Marines land on Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands to take a Japanese airfield; six months of fighting on land, at sea and in the air follow until Japan withdraws in February 1943.
summary.zh: 美国海军陆战队在所罗门群岛的瓜达尔卡纳尔岛登陆，夺取日军机场；陆上、海上、空中的战斗持续半年，1943 年 2 月日军撤出。

detail.en: About 10,000 troops were ashore on Guadalcanal by the evening of 7 August. In all about 60,000 US Army and Marine ground troops served on the island; about 1,600 were killed and 4,245 wounded. Of more than 36,000 Japanese who fought there, over 14,800 were killed or missing, 9,000 died of disease and about 1,000 were taken prisoner. These are ground-force figures; both navies also lost many ships and men in the waters around the island.
detail.zh: 8 月 7 日晚已有约 1 万人登上瓜岛。先后约 6 万名美国陆军和陆战队地面部队在岛上作战，约 1,600 人阵亡、4,245 人负伤。3.6 万多名日军中，1.48 万多人阵亡或失踪，9,000 人病死，约 1,000 人被俘。这些只是地面部队的数字；双方海军在岛屿周围的海域也损失了大批舰船和人员。

summary.en: German troops fight their way into Stalingrad on the Volga; on 19 November the Red Army counter-attacks and encircles the German Sixth Army, which surrenders by 2 February 1943; over 91,000 men are taken prisoner.
summary.zh: 德军一条街一条街地打进伏尔加河畔的斯大林格勒；11 月 19 日红军反攻，合围德国第 6 集团军，到 1943 年 2 月 2 日全部投降，9.1 万多人被俘。

detail.en: The Soviet counter-offensive of 19 November, about 1,000,000 men, struck the Romanian armies holding the German flanks and closed the ring near Kalach on 22–23 November around almost 290,000 men. Field Marshal Paulus surrendered on 31 January and the last pocket on 2 February. Over 91,000 were captured, 24 generals among them; almost half had died by spring, and only about 5,000 ever came home. The Germans lost somewhat over 200,000 men in the pocket. The Red Army's losses in the campaign were 1.1 million, of whom 485,751 died. The Soviet Union did not publish its own losses at the time.
detail.zh: 11 月 19 日，约 100 万苏军发起反攻，打击守卫德军两翼的罗马尼亚军队，11 月 22 至 23 日在卡拉奇附近合围了将近 29 万人。保卢斯元帅 1 月 31 日投降，最后一个包围圈 2 月 2 日投降。9.1 万多人被俘，其中有 24 名将军；到春天已死去将近一半，最终只有约 5,000 人回到家乡。德军在包围圈中损失 20 万多人。红军在整个战役中损失 110 万人，其中 485,751 人死亡；苏联当时没有公布自己的损失。

summary.en: Britain's Eighth Army, about 195,000 men, breaks through the German and Italian army in Egypt; by 4 November the Axis forces are retreating west.
summary.zh: 约 19.5 万人的英国第 8 集团军在埃及突破德意军队防线；到 11 月 4 日，轴心国军队向西撤退。

detail.en: The Eighth Army included British, Australian, New Zealand, Indian and South African troops and had 1,029 tanks fit for action against about 50,000 Germans and 54,000 Italians. Its casualties were about 13,560. By 11 November about 30,000 Axis soldiers, 7,802 German and 22,071 Italian, had been taken prisoner.
detail.zh: 第 8 集团军包括英国、澳大利亚、新西兰、印度和南非的部队，有可用坦克 1,029 辆，对面是约 5 万德军和 5.4 万意军。第 8 集团军伤亡约 13,560 人。到 11 月 11 日，约 3 万名轴心国士兵被俘，其中德军 7,802 人、意军 22,071 人。

summary.en: More than 100,000 American and British troops land in French Morocco and Algeria; Vichy French forces resist until a ceasefire on 10–11 November.
summary.zh: 10 万多名美英军队在法属摩洛哥和阿尔及利亚登陆；维希法国军队抵抗到 11 月 10 至 11 日停火。

detail.en: Three task forces landed on 8 November: the Western from the United States near Casablanca (33,843 men), and the Center (Oran) and Eastern (Algiers) from Britain. The marker is at Oran. On 10 November Admiral Darlan ordered the French forces, in Pétain's name, to stop fighting; Casablanca surrendered on 11 November. The campaign that followed ended in Tunisia on 13 May 1943.
detail.zh: 11 月 8 日三支特遣舰队登陆：西路从美国出发，在卡萨布兰卡附近上岸（33,843 人）；中路（奥兰）和东路（阿尔及尔）从英国出发。图上标记在奥兰。11 月 10 日，达尔朗海军上将以贝当的名义命令法军停火；卡萨布兰卡 11 月 11 日投降。此后的战役在 1943 年 5 月 13 日于突尼斯结束。

title.zh: 轴心国军队在突尼斯投降

summary.en: The last German and Italian forces in North Africa surrender; about 250,000–275,000 men become prisoners.
summary.zh: 北非最后的德意军队投降，约 25 万至 27.5 万人被俘。

detail.en: The Italian First Army's commander, Marshal Messe, surrendered on 13 May. The US Army history counts about 275,000 prisoners taken in the last week; the National WWII Museum gives a quarter of a million. Both are listed. Two months later the Allies landed in Sicily.
detail.zh: 意大利第 1 集团军司令梅塞元帅 5 月 13 日投降。美国陆军战史统计最后一周俘虏约 27.5 万人，美国国家二战博物馆的说法是约 25 万人，两者并列。两个月后，盟军在西西里登陆。

summary.en: Germany's last major offensive in the east, with more than 780,000 men and nearly 3,000 tanks, fails against more than 1.9 million Soviet troops; the Red Army counter-attacks and takes Kharkov on 23 August.
summary.zh: 德国在东线的最后一次大攻势：78 万多人、近 3,000 辆坦克，对阵 190 多万苏军，进攻失败；红军反攻，8 月 23 日夺回哈尔科夫。

detail.en: Germany attacked the Kursk salient from north and south on 5 July. On 12 July, with the Allies ashore in Sicily, Hitler decided to move troops to Italy. From then on the Red Army held the initiative in the east. Other estimates of the forces differ; these are the National WWII Museum's figures.
detail.zh: 7 月 5 日德军从南北两面进攻库尔斯克突出部。7 月 12 日，盟军已在西西里登陆，希特勒决定调兵去意大利。从此东线的主动权在红军手里。兵力的其他估计不一，这里用的是美国国家二战博物馆的数字。

summary.en: After an Allied commando raid on Singapore harbour, the Kempeitai raid Changi Prison and take away 57 civilian internees; 15 die under interrogation.
summary.zh: 盟军突击队袭击新加坡港之后，宪兵队搜查樟宜监狱，带走 57 名被拘留的平民，其中 15 人死于审讯。

detail.en: On 26 September 1943 fourteen Australian and British commandos in canoes sank or damaged about 37,000 tonnes of shipping in the harbour (Operation Jaywick). The Kempeitai wrongly suspected the internees and local people of helping the raiders, and found a hidden wireless set in the prison. The suspects, among them Elizabeth Choy and her husband, were held and tortured at the Kempeitai's East District Branch in the old YMCA. From 18 March to 15 April 1946 a British military court in Singapore tried 21 Japanese soldiers and interpreters for the Double Tenth.
detail.zh: 1943 年 9 月 26 日，14 名澳大利亚和英国突击队员乘独木舟潜入港内，击沉或炸伤约 37,000 吨船只（杰威克行动）。宪兵队错误地怀疑是被拘留者和本地人接应了袭击者，并在监狱里搜出一台藏起来的无线电。嫌疑人，包括伊丽莎白·蔡和她的丈夫，被关在旧基督教青年会大楼里的宪兵队东区分队，遭到拷打。1946 年 3 月 18 日至 4 月 15 日，英国军事法庭在新加坡就双十事件审判了 21 名日本军人和翻译。

summary.en: A Japanese offensive in Hunan reaches Changde; the Chinese 57th Division holds the city for eleven days, it falls on 3 December, and Chinese forces retake it six days later.
summary.zh: 日军在湖南发动攻势，打到常德；中国第 57 师守城 11 天，12 月 3 日城陷，六天后中国军队收复常德。

detail.en: The offensive began on 2 November 1943. In the city, 8,529 men of the 57th Division fought the Japanese 116th Division from 23 November; by the division's own report 7,869 of them were killed or wounded. Chinese reports of the time recorded Japanese use of poison gas in the campaign. The Japanese withdrew, and Changde was back in Chinese hands by 9 December.
detail.zh: 攻势在 1943 年 11 月 2 日开始。11 月 23 日起，第 57 师 8,529 名官兵在城中抵抗日军第 116 师团；据该师战报，伤亡 7,869 人。中国方面当时的报告记载日军在会战中使用了毒气。日军撤走，常德到 12 月 9 日重回中国军队手中。

summary.en: A Japanese offensive into north-east India, with an Indian National Army division, is stopped at Imphal and Kohima; Japan's Fifteenth Army loses 53,000 of its 85,000 men, many to hunger.
summary.zh: 日军连同一个印度国民军师进攻印度东北部，在英帕尔和科希马被挡住；日军第 15 军 8.5 万人中有 5.3 万人死亡或失踪，许多人是饿死的。

detail.en: Lieutenant-General Mutaguchi's plan relied on capturing British supplies; when that failed his men starved in the monsoon. The British and Indian garrisons, surrounded, were supplied by air: the RAF flew in nearly 19,000 tons of supplies and over 12,000 men. British and Indian casualties were about 12,500 at Imphal and 4,000 at Kohima. The defeat opened the way for the Fourteenth Army's reconquest of Burma.
detail.zh: 牟田口廉也中将的计划靠缴获英军物资补给，落空之后，他的部队在雨季中挨饿。被包围的英印守军靠空投维持：皇家空军运进近 1.9 万吨物资和 1.2 万多人。英印军在英帕尔伤亡约 12,500 人，在科希马伤亡 4,000 人。这次失败为第 14 集团军收复缅甸打开了道路。

summary.en: 156,115 American, British, Canadian and other Allied soldiers land in Normandy by sea and air; about 10,500 Allied soldiers are killed, wounded, missing or captured on the first day.
summary.zh: 156,115 名美国、英国、加拿大和其他盟国士兵从海上和空中在诺曼底登陆；第一天盟军伤亡、失踪和被俘约 10,500 人。

detail.en: About 132,000 men came ashore on five beaches; the rest came by parachute and glider. A deception plan (Fortitude) had persuaded the Germans that the main landing would come later at the Pas de Calais, so divisions were held there for weeks. German losses on the day are estimated at about 10,000. The Allies broke out of Normandy at the end of July and reached Paris on 25 August.
detail.zh: 约 13.2 万人在五处海滩上岸，其余的人乘降落伞和滑翔机着陆。欺敌计划（坚忍行动）让德军相信主力登陆会在之后的加来海峡，德军的师因此在那里等了好几周。德军当天的损失估计约 1 万人。盟军 7 月底突破诺曼底，8 月 25 日到达巴黎。

summary.en: The Red Army's summer offensive in Belorussia destroys 28 of the 34 divisions of three German armies; Germany loses about 400,000 men, and Soviet troops reach the Vistula near Warsaw.
summary.zh: 红军在白俄罗斯的夏季攻势消灭了德军三个集团军 34 个师中的 28 个；德军损失约 40 万人，苏军推进到华沙附近的维斯瓦河。

detail.en: About 1.2 million Soviet troops, 2.5 million with reserves, attacked an Army Group Center of slightly over 700,000 men; the offensive opened on 22–23 June, three years after the German invasion. The Red Army lost about 180,000 killed and missing and more than half a million wounded and sick. Minsk was retaken on 3 July.
detail.zh: 约 120 万苏军（连同预备队 250 万）进攻略多于 70 万人的德国中央集团军群；攻势在 6 月 22 日至 23 日展开，距德国入侵正好三年。红军阵亡和失踪约 18 万人，负伤和患病 50 万人以上。7 月 3 日收复明斯克。

summary.en: The Polish Home Army rises against the German occupation and fights for 63 days; the Germans crush the uprising, murder about 40,000 civilians in the Wola district alone and raze the city centre.
summary.zh: 波兰家乡军起义反抗德国占领，坚持 63 天；德军镇压起义，仅在沃拉区就屠杀了约 4 万平民，随后把市中心夷为平地。

detail.en: About 45,000 Home Army fighters took part. The Red Army had reached the Vistula east of the city but did not cross to help the insurgents. USHMM gives 166,000 dead, among them perhaps 17,000 Polish Jews who had fought or been found in hiding, and elsewhere more than 180,000; most were civilians. More than 11,000 Home Army soldiers were taken prisoner, and civilians were deported to concentration and forced-labour camps.
detail.zh: 约 4.5 万名家乡军战士参加了起义。红军已经推进到城东的维斯瓦河边，却没有渡河援助起义者。美国大屠杀纪念馆一处记载死亡 16.6 万人，其中可能有 1.7 万名参战或在藏匿中被发现的波兰犹太人，另一处说超过 18 万人；死者大多是平民。1.1 万多名家乡军士兵被俘，平民被押送到集中营和强迫劳动营。

summary.en: The French 2nd Armoured Division and French resistance fighters free Paris; the German commander, General von Choltitz, surrenders on the afternoon of 25 August.
summary.zh: 法国第 2 装甲师和法国抵抗力量解放巴黎；德军指挥官肖尔蒂茨将军 8 月 25 日下午投降。

title.zh: 莱特岛登陆与莱特湾海战

summary.en: US forces land on Leyte to retake the Philippines; in the Battle of Leyte Gulf (23–26 October), the largest naval battle ever fought, Japan loses 26 ships, and the first organised kamikaze attacks begin.
summary.zh: 美军在莱特岛登陆反攻菲律宾；在史上规模最大的莱特湾海战（10 月 23 日至 26 日）中，日本损失 26 艘舰船，有组织的神风特攻第一次出现。

detail.en: Japan lost three battleships, Musashi among them, and four carriers. Kamikaze pilots, who deliberately crashed their aircraft into ships, would kill thousands of Allied sailors in the remaining months of the war.
detail.zh: 日本损失三艘战列舰（包括武藏号）和四艘航母。神风特攻队员驾机故意撞向军舰，在战争最后几个月里造成数千名盟军水兵死亡。

summary.en: Germany's last offensive in the west strikes through the Ardennes forest; it is stopped and pushed back by late January at a cost of over 89,000 American casualties, 19,000 of them killed.
summary.zh: 德国在西线的最后一次攻势穿过阿登森林；到 1 月下旬被挡住并击退，美军伤亡 8.9 万多人，其中阵亡 1.9 万人。

summary.en: Soviet troops reach Auschwitz and find about 7,000 prisoners, most of them ill; about 1.1 million people had been killed there, about 1 million of them Jews.
summary.zh: 苏军到达奥斯威辛，发现约 7,000 名囚犯，大多病重；约 110 万人在这里被杀害，其中约 100 万是犹太人。

detail.en: Auschwitz-Birkenau was the largest of the Nazi camps, both a concentration camp and a killing centre with gas chambers. Its victims were about 1 million Jews, 70,000–75,000 Poles, 21,000 Roma and Sinti, 15,000 Soviet prisoners of war and 10,000–15,000 others. In the weeks before, the SS had driven tens of thousands of prisoners west on death marches, on which at least 9,000 died, and had blown up the crematoria and burned records. 27 January is now International Holocaust Remembrance Day.
detail.zh: 奥斯威辛—比克瑙是纳粹最大的营地，既是集中营，也是设有毒气室的灭绝营。遇难者包括约 100 万犹太人、7 万至 7.5 万波兰人、2.1 万罗姆人和辛提人、1.5 万苏军战俘以及 1 万至 1.5 万其他人。在此前几周，党卫队把数万名囚犯赶上向西的“死亡行军”，途中至少 9,000 人死亡，又炸毁焚尸场、烧毁档案。1 月 27 日今天是国际大屠杀纪念日。

summary.en: British and American bombers attack Dresden over three days and nights; the firestorm kills up to 25,000 people, according to the city's historians' commission (2010).
summary.zh: 英美轰炸机连续三天三夜轰炸德累斯顿；据该市历史学家委员会（2010）的结论，大火造成最多 2.5 万人死亡。

detail.en: The first RAF wave of 240 Lancasters came at about 10 p.m. on 13 February and a second of about 550 later that night; US B-17s followed on 14 and 15 February. For decades much higher figures were claimed; the commission's figure, from five years of research, is up to 25,000. Whether the raid was militarily necessary is still argued.
detail.zh: 2 月 13 日晚约 10 时，英国空军第一波 240 架兰开斯特飞到，当夜晚些时候第二波约 550 架；14 日和 15 日美国 B-17 接着轰炸。几十年来流传着高得多的数字；委员会经过五年研究得出的数字是最多 2.5 万人。这次轰炸在军事上是否必要，至今仍有争论。

summary.en: About 70,000 US Marines take the island of Iwo Jima in 36 days; nearly 7,000 Marines are killed, and of 18,000 Japanese defenders only 216 are taken prisoner.
summary.zh: 约 7 万名美国海军陆战队员用 36 天攻下硫磺岛；近 7,000 名陆战队员阵亡，1.8 万名日本守军只有 216 人被俘。

summary.en: 279 American B-29s drop incendiary bombs on eastern Tokyo at night; more than 100,000 people die and over a million are left homeless.
summary.zh: 279 架美国 B-29 夜间向东京东部投下燃烧弹；10 万多人死亡，100 多万人无家可归。

detail.en: The bombers came in low, and the fires spread through the wooden houses of the districts along the Sumida River, including Asakusa and Nihonbashi. People died of burns, suffocation, drowning in the canals and cold. Sixteen square miles of the city were burned out.
detail.zh: 轰炸机低空飞行，大火在隅田川两岸木屋密集的街区蔓延，包括浅草和日本桥。人们被烧死、窒息、在运河里淹死或冻死。城市 16 平方英里被烧光。

summary.en: The last great battle of the Pacific war; about 110,000 Japanese and Okinawan defenders, over 100,000 Okinawan civilians and 12,520 Americans die.
summary.zh: 太平洋战争最后一场大战；约 11 万名日本和冲绳守军、10 万多名冲绳平民和 12,520 名美国人死亡。

detail.en: Estimates of civilian deaths reach a third of the island's pre-war population. Civilians were caught between the armies, and some were driven to suicide. Okinawa Prefecture's Cornerstone of Peace lists 242,225 names of people of all nations who died in the battle and the war in Okinawa (2024).
detail.zh: 对平民死亡的估计高达全岛战前人口的三分之一。平民夹在两军之间，有些人被逼自杀。冲绳县的“和平基石”刻有 242,225 个名字，是在冲绳战役和冲绳的战争中死去的各国人员（2024）。

summary.en: 2.5 million Soviet troops attack Berlin; on 25 April American and Soviet soldiers meet on the Elbe at Torgau, Hitler kills himself on 30 April, and the city surrenders on 2 May.
summary.zh: 250 万苏军进攻柏林；4 月 25 日美苏士兵在易北河畔托尔高会师，4 月 30 日希特勒自杀，5 月 2 日柏林投降。

summary.en: Germany's unconditional surrender, signed at Reims on 7 May and ratified in Berlin, takes effect at 23.01 on 8 May; the war in Europe is over. In Moscow it is already 9 May, the date the Soviet Union celebrated.
summary.zh: 德国 5 月 7 日在兰斯签署、在柏林批准的无条件投降，于 5 月 8 日 23 时 01 分生效，欧洲战争结束。莫斯科那时已是 5 月 9 日，苏联在这一天庆祝胜利。

summary.en: A US B-29 drops an atomic bomb on Hiroshima at 8.15 a.m.; about half the people within 1.2 km of the hypocentre die that day, and by the end of 1945 roughly 140,000 are dead.
summary.zh: 上午 8 时 15 分，一架美国 B-29 在广岛投下原子弹；距爆心 1.2 公里内的人约有一半当天死亡，到 1945 年底死亡约 14 万人。

detail.en: An American report of 1946 counted 66,000 killed and 69,000 injured. Later estimates are higher because they include people who died of burns, injuries and radiation sickness in the following months: the City of Hiroshima gives roughly 140,000 by the end of December 1945, and the Japan–US Radiation Effects Research Foundation 90,000–166,000 within two to four months, in a city of 340,000–350,000. Exact numbers are unknown; records were destroyed and whole families died.
detail.zh: 1946 年美方报告统计死亡 66,000 人、受伤 69,000 人。后来的估计更高，因为计入了此后几个月里死于烧伤、外伤和放射病的人：广岛市的数字是到 1945 年 12 月底约 14 万人，日美合办的放射线影响研究所估计两到四个月内死亡 9 万至 16.6 万人，而当时全市人口是 34 万至 35 万。确切数字无从得知：档案被毁，整户人家死去。

summary.en: The Soviet Union declares war on Japan and attacks Manchuria with about 1.58 million men on three fronts; the main operation is over within seven days.
summary.zh: 苏联对日宣战，约 158 万苏军从三个方向进攻满洲；主要作战七天内结束。

detail.en: The Soviet Union had promised at Yalta to enter the war against Japan three months after Germany's defeat. Shortly after midnight on 9 August, Manchurian time, its armies crossed the border from Mongolia, the Soviet Far East and the Amur. Japanese and puppet forces numbered about 1.2 million, many of them newly raised. Soviet estimates give 84,000 Japanese killed and 594,000 taken prisoner, and Soviet losses of 8,000 killed and 24,000 wounded; fighting continued after Japan's announcement of 15 August, until about 20 August. Many of the prisoners were taken to labour camps in the Soviet Union.
detail.zh: 苏联在雅尔塔承诺德国投降三个月后对日作战。8 月 9 日（满洲时间）午夜刚过，苏军从蒙古、苏联远东和黑龙江对岸越过边界。日本和傀儡军队约 120 万人，其中许多是新征召的。苏方估计日军阵亡 8.4 万、被俘 59.4 万，苏军阵亡 8,000、负伤 2.4 万；日本 8 月 15 日宣布投降后战斗仍在继续，直到 8 月 20 日前后。许多俘虏被押到苏联的劳动营。

summary.en: A second atomic bomb destroys the industrial valley of Nagasaki at 11.02 a.m.; by the end of December 1945, 73,884 people have died.
summary.zh: 上午 11 时 02 分，第二颗原子弹摧毁长崎的工业谷地；到 1945 年 12 月底，73,884 人死亡。

detail.en: An American report of 1946 counted 39,000 killed and 25,000 injured; the City of Nagasaki's figure for the end of 1945 is 73,884 killed and 74,909 injured, in a city of about 240,000; the Radiation Effects Research Foundation estimates 60,000–80,000 deaths within two to four months. Survivors, called hibakusha, suffered radiation illness for years afterwards.
detail.zh: 1946 年美方报告统计死亡 39,000 人、受伤 25,000 人；长崎市的数字是到 1945 年底死亡 73,884 人、受伤 74,909 人，当时全市约 24 万人；放射线影响研究所估计两到四个月内死亡 6 万至 8 万人。幸存者（被爆者）此后多年受放射病之苦。

summary.en: At noon Emperor Hirohito's recorded broadcast tells the Japanese people that Japan accepts the Allied terms; the word 'surrender' is not used.
summary.zh: 正午，裕仁天皇的录音广播告诉日本国民，日本接受盟国的条件；广播里没有用“投降”一词。

detail.en: The rescript said the war situation had developed 'not necessarily to Japan's advantage' and that the enemy had begun to use 'a new and most cruel bomb'. 15 August is marked as the end of the war in Japan and Korea and as VJ Day in Britain; China commemorates its victory on 3 September, the day after the formal signing.
detail.zh: 诏书说战局“未必好转”，敌方使用了“新的残虐炸弹”。在日本和朝鲜半岛，8 月 15 日被视为战争结束的日子，英国称之为对日胜利日；中国把正式签字的次日，9 月 3 日，定为胜利纪念日。

summary.en: Japan's representatives sign the Instrument of Surrender aboard USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay; General MacArthur signs for the Allied Powers.
summary.zh: 日本代表在东京湾的密苏里号上签署投降书；麦克阿瑟将军代表盟国签字。

detail.en: Foreign Minister Shigemitsu Mamoru and General Umezu Yoshijirō signed for Japan at 9.04 a.m.; representatives of the United States, China, the United Kingdom, the Soviet Union, Australia, Canada, France, the Netherlands and New Zealand signed after MacArthur. The Second World War, which in China had begun in 1937, was formally over.
detail.zh: 上午 9 时 04 分，外务大臣重光葵和梅津美治郎大将代表日本签字；麦克阿瑟之后，美国、中国、英国、苏联、澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、荷兰、新西兰的代表依次签字。在中国从 1937 年打起的这场战争，至此正式结束。

summary.en: In the Municipal Building, Admiral Lord Louis Mountbatten accepts the surrender of all Japanese forces in Southeast Asia from General Itagaki Seishirō.
summary.zh: 在市政大厦，蒙巴顿海军上将接受板垣征四郎大将代表东南亚全部日军投降。

detail.en: British troops had landed on 5 September, after the Japanese commanders signed the surrender of Singapore and Johore aboard HMS Sussex on 4 September; there were about 77,000 Japanese army, air force and naval personnel in Singapore and Johore. At the ceremony Itagaki signed eleven copies of the Instrument of Surrender, for the British, American, Chinese, French, Dutch, Australian, Indian and Japanese governments, the King, the Supreme Commander and the command's records. A victory parade followed on the Padang. Itagaki was later tried in Tokyo and hanged in 1948.
detail.zh: 9 月 4 日日军指挥官在萨塞克斯号上签署新加坡和柔佛的投降书，英军 9 月 5 日登陆；当时新加坡和柔佛有日本陆海空军约 7.7 万人。仪式上，板垣签署了十一份投降书，分别给英国、美国、中国、法国、荷兰、澳大利亚、印度和日本政府，以及英王、最高统帅和司令部存档。随后在大草场举行胜利游行。板垣后来在东京受审，1948 年被处绞刑。

summary.en: A British military court in Singapore tries seven Japanese officers for the Sook Ching massacre; two are sentenced to death and five to life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 英国军事法庭在新加坡审判七名与肃清屠杀有关的日本军官；两人被判死刑，五人终身监禁。

detail.en: The trial was held at the Victoria Memorial Hall from 10 March to 2 April 1947. All seven were found guilty; Lieutenant-General Kawamura Saburō, garrison commander of Singapore Town, and Lieutenant-Colonel Oishi Masayuki, the Kempeitai commander, were sentenced to death. It was one of 131 war-crimes trials held in Singapore between January 1946 and March 1948. The Japanese figure for the dead given at the trial, about 5,000, is far below most estimates.
detail.zh: 审判 1947 年 3 月 10 日至 4 月 2 日在维多利亚纪念堂举行。七人全部有罪；新加坡市区警备司令河村参郎中将和宪兵队指挥官大石正幸中佐被判死刑。这是 1946 年 1 月至 1948 年 3 月间新加坡 131 场战犯审判之一。审判中日方提出的遇难人数约 5,000 人，远低于大多数估计。

summary.en: Where Japanese soldiers killed about 200 patients and staff on 14–15 February 1942, the day before the surrender.
summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月 14 至 15 日，投降前一天，日军士兵在这里杀害了约 200 名病人和医护人员。

summary.en: Where Percival signed the surrender of Singapore on 15 February 1942; now a National Monument and museum.
summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月 15 日白思华签字投降的地方；今天是国家古迹和展馆。

detail.en: The factory on Upper Bukit Timah Road had opened in October 1941 as Ford's first car assembly plant in Southeast Asia. Percival signed the unconditional surrender in its boardroom; during the occupation Nissan assembled military vehicles there.
detail.zh: 这座位于武吉知马路上段的工厂 1941 年 10 月投产，是福特在东南亚的第一座汽车装配厂。白思华在厂里的会议室签署无条件投降书；日据时期日产公司在这里组装军用车辆。

title.zh: 宪兵队东区分队（旧青年会大楼）

summary.en: The Japanese military police headquarters for eastern Singapore, where suspects were held and tortured, including after the Double Tenth.
summary.zh: 日本宪兵在新加坡东区的总部，嫌疑人被关押、拷打的地方，双十事件后也是如此。

detail.en: The Art Deco YMCA building on Stamford Road was run by Lieutenant-Colonel Oishi Masayuki, sentenced to death in 1947 for the Sook Ching, with about 200 regular Kempeitai and 1,000 auxiliaries. Elizabeth Choy and her husband were held here. The building was pulled down in 1981; a marker stands at the site.
detail.zh: 史丹福路上这座装饰艺术风格的青年会大楼，由大石正幸中佐指挥（1947 年他因肃清被判死刑）；手下有正规宪兵约 200 人、辅助宪兵 1,000 人。伊丽莎白·蔡和丈夫曾被关在这里。大楼于 1981 年拆除，原址立有史迹标志。

summary.en: Civilian internment camp from February 1942, when more than 2,500 civilians and POWs were packed into it; scene of the Double Tenth raid.
summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月起成为平民拘留营，2,500 多名平民和战俘被塞进这里；双十事件的发生地。

detail.en: European civilians were marched to Changi on 17 February 1942. Prisoners of war were held in the Changi area; some 87,000 passed through Changi during the war, and many were sent on to the Burma–Thailand Railway. The gate, part of the wall and two turrets of the 1936 prison survive as a National Monument.
detail.zh: 1942 年 2 月 17 日，欧洲平民被押往樟宜。战俘关在樟宜一带；战争期间约有 87,000 名战俘经过樟宜，许多人又被送去修泰缅铁路。这座 1936 年建成的监狱，大门、一段围墙和两座塔楼保留了下来，是国家古迹。

summary.en: On 20 February 1942, 66 Chinese men were shot at the water's edge here by auxiliary military police firing squads during the Sook Ching.
summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月 20 日，66 名华人男子在这里的水边被辅助宪兵行刑队枪杀，这是肃清的一部分。

summary.en: On 28 February 1942 some 400 Chinese civilians, victims of the Sook Ching, were killed on this north-eastern shore.
summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月 28 日，约 400 名华人平民在这片东北海岸被杀，他们是肃清的受害者。

summary.en: Where Mountbatten accepted the surrender of Japanese forces in Southeast Asia on 12 September 1945.
summary.zh: 1945 年 9 月 12 日蒙巴顿在这里接受东南亚日军投降。

detail.en: In February 1942 the Japanese assembled European civilians and prisoners on the Padang in front of the building before marching them to Changi. After the war it was renamed City Hall (1951); Singapore's first elected cabinet was sworn in here in 1959, and the Proclamation of Malaysia was read from its steps on 16 September 1963.
detail.zh: 1942 年 2 月，日军把欧洲平民和战俘集中在大厦前的大草场，再押往樟宜。战后大厦于 1951 年改称市政厅；1959 年新加坡第一届民选内阁在这里宣誓就职，1963 年 9 月 16 日在大厦台阶上宣读了马来西亚成立宣言。
